description: This file defines a mock class 'MockUserRoleManager' used for testing purposes in the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. The class extends 'AbstractUserRoleManager' and implements methods related to user role and permission management, but all methods throw exceptions indicating they are placeholders for testing and should not be called in production.
